title: Mweya Wakavimbika weZvakazarurwa
intro: Munzvimbo dzisingaonekwi, chisikwa chine chiedza chakachena chinofamba nemazvo, chichitevedzera mirairo yese pasina kuzeza. Munhu uyu akataura nevaranda vakasarudzwa, akaunza mashoko ekutungamira, uye akaona kuzarurwa kwemitemo yaMwari mumazana emakore. Ndiani mweya uyu unokudzwa?
clues: Ndiri chisikwa chechiedza chakachena, chakasikwa kubva kuchiedza, uye handina kumbobvira ndatyora murairo waIshe wangu.
Ndinofamba pakati pedenga nenyika, ndichiburuka nemirairo yeAne Ngoni Zvikuru.
Ndakatumwa kumhandara ine mukurumbira munzvimbo tsvene, ndichiizivisa mwanakomana akachena.
Ndiri mweya weutsvene, uye ndakatsigira muporofita akapihwa zviratidzo zvakajeka neEvhangeri.
Ndakasvika pabako riri pagomo kuti nditaure mashoko ekutanga ekudzokorora aizoramba akachengetedzwa nekusingaperi.
Ndini mweya wakavimbika, uye ndini ndakaunza Quran pasi pamoyo wemutumwa wekupedzisira.

options: Gehena rakachengetedzwa uye masuo aro akavharwa

verse: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel] (81:19)
